integrity: The calculation follows the source definitions of the inner derivation, pseudo-linear component codes, direct-sum decomposition, and coordinatewise Gray map. A four-coordinate explicit word proves the upper bound, and exhaustive exact arithmetic proves the replacement parameters.
scientific_limitations: The result corrects only the printed \(q=4\), \(l=3\), \(n=4\) Table 2 row. It does not rule out other quaternary \([12,5,6]\) codes and does not by itself refute the paper's general structural theorems.
title: Table 2's quaternary Gray image has parameters \([12,5,4]_4\), not \([12,5,6]_4\)
